sections.sectionSummaryBrief: Based on the earlier point that the primary dwelling of the Shechinah in the lower realms emphasizes two aspects, the advantage of the current drawing down after the withdrawal is in both of these aspects: the revelation is loftier than before the sin, and its drawing into the world is more internal.

translations.translation: And according to the above
(section 2)
that in the primary dwelling of the Shechinah in the lower realms, two matters are emphasized – the primary dwelling
(which is above worlds),
and in the lower realms
(that this primary aspect being in the lower realms is
(also)
due to the nature of the lower realms themselves)
– it must be said,
that the advantage in the drawing down of the primary dwelling of the Shechinah in the lower realms after it withdrew, relative to how it was at the beginning of creation,
is in both matters.
That the G-dly revelation drawn down through the service of man now is a revelation more elevated than the revelation drawn down through the service of Adam before the sin,
and that the drawing down of the revelation into the world
(in the lower realms)
now is in a more internal manner.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: To understand this, it is prefaced with an explanation of the earlier point that although sin is contrary to the Supernal Will, it is intentional, rooted in the diminution of the moon, the breaking of the vessels of Tohu, and ultimately the first tzimtzum which is a withdrawal and like a reversal of the Will, providing the place for sin.

translations.translation: And this will be understood by prefacing an explanation of what was brought above, that although sin
(the sin of the Tree of Knowledge,
and likewise all sins)
is the opposite of the Supernal Will,
nevertheless it is intentional.
And the matter is as stated by the Baal HaHilula in the maamarim of the Festival of Redemption42,
that just as every thing below has a root and source above,
so too regarding sin and iniquity,
there is a cause and a place for this above.
And he brings a proof for this from the first sin that was in the world,
which is the sin of the Tree of Knowledge.
For at first glance it is perplexing,
behold Adam was at the ultimate level of elevation, both regarding his soul, for his wisdom was greater than the wisdom of the separate intellects43,
and regarding his body, for the body of Adam was the handiwork of the Holy One, blessed be He44,
and the heel of Adam would outshine the orb of the sun45,
so how is it possible that he sinned and transgressed the command of G-d?
And to add,
that according to the statement of our sages, of blessed memory46,
that the reason man was created alone is to teach us that every single Jew is analogous to Adam,
it must be said,
that the wonder of how the matter of sin is possible applies also to each and every Jew47.
For since the second soul within him is literally a part of G-d above48,
and also regarding the body of Israel it is stated49
"And You have chosen us from every nation and tongue," and it is brought in Tanya50
that this refers to the physical body which is similar in its materiality to the bodies of the nations of the world,
and according to the known principle51
that the true essence of the matter of choice is in the Atzmus,
it is understood,
that in the body of Israel there is an advantage even over the soul,
for in it
(in the body)
specifically is the choice of the Atzmus,
how is it possible that there be sin in Israel?
And the explanation of this
(in the aforementioned maamar of the Baal HaHilula),
is that the cause and the place for sin
(simply,
below)
in the matters above is the diminution of the moon52.
And higher than that,
the cause and place for sin is – the breaking of the vessels of Tohu.
That is, the creation of the world of Tohu,
a world that did not benefit Him53
(therefore there was the breaking in it),
is
(like)
the opposite of the Will.
Therefore it is a cause and place for sin.
And higher than that,
the cause and place for sin is – the first tzimtzum which was in the manner of withdrawal.
For the Supernal Will is that there be a revelation of light,
and the withdrawal of the light
(the first tzimtzum)
is
(like)
the opposite of the Will
[for although the intention of the tzimtzum is for the sake of revelation,
nevertheless the tzimtzum itself is the opposite of the Will54].
And the matter of the opposite of the Will
(as it were)
that is in the first tzimtzum is a cause and place
(through the breaking of the vessels of Tohu and the diminution of the moon)
for sin,
which is the opposite of the Will in its simple sense.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: The proof that even the matter of the opposite of the Will is intentional is primarily from the first tzimtzum, for the intention of the tzimtzum in the light is for revelation in the worlds, while the intention in the tzimtzum itself is to reveal the aspect of concealment that stems from the ability of the Atzmus, which is connected to the concept of a dwelling place in the lower realms.

translations.translation: And it should be noted,
that the proof that even the matter of the opposite of the Will is intentional,
is primarily from the first tzimtzum.
For the diminution of the moon,
although the Holy One, blessed be He, diminished the moon,
nevertheless the cause for this was the accusation of the moon55.
And also the breaking of the vessels of Tohu,
although the creation of the world of Tohu was initially in a manner of building with the intent to demolish56,
it can be said,
that through the existence of the tzimtzum,
which is the root of the coming into being of the worlds,
it was determined that the coming into being of the world of Tikkun would be after the building and demolition of Tohu57,
building with the intent to demolish and demolishing with the intent to build56.
And the primary proof that even the matter of the opposite of the Will is not by chance, G-d forbid, but rather intentional, is from the first tzimtzum.
For regarding the tzimtzum, it cannot be said that there was a necessity, as it were, for the tzimtzum in order for the coming into being of the worlds to be possible,
for the entire matter of the coming into being of the worlds
(world [olam] means concealment58)
is due to the tzimtzum.
For the desire for worlds in the Ein Sof before the tzimtzum is that there be worlds in which there will be a revelation of the light.
For since the matter of light is revelation,
also the desire for worlds that was in the light is
(not for the worlds themselves,
but rather)
for the revelation that will be in the worlds.
And from this it is understood,
that the intention in the tzimtzum
[the withdrawal of the light,
in order that worlds whose nature is concealment should come into being]
is not only in order that through this the desire for worlds that was initially in the light before the tzimtzum will be fulfilled59,
but rather there is in this another intention60,
which is the opposite of the desire that was initially61.
And that is,
that the intention of the tzimtzum as it is in the light
(that the Ein Sof contracted Himself)
is that there be revelation in the worlds that come into being from the tzimtzum,
and the intention of the tzimtzum as it is in the tzimtzum itself is – that in it is revealed the matter of concealment which is above revelation,
and that is that the Atzmus is not compelled, G-d forbid, in the matter of revelation, and it is within His ability to be
(also)
in concealment.
Rather, the revelation of the matter of concealment
[that the concealment is because the Atzmus is not compelled, G-d forbid, in the matter of revelation]
is through the revelation that is drawn down after the tzimtzum.
For through the revelation that is drawn down in the worlds that came into being from the tzimtzum,
they are able to sense
(in addition to the sensation of revelation)
also the root and cause of the concealment within them,
which is from the aspect of the ability of the Atzmus.
[And this can be connected to the matter of a dwelling place in the lower realms,
that this lowly physical world becomes a dwelling place for the Atzmus,
for in this world is the primary concealment,
and through it being revealed that the concealment within it is from the aspect of the ability of the Atzmus,
it becomes a dwelling place for the Atzmus].
